title: bolbitis virens var. deltigera
intro: Bolbitis virens var. deltigera, commonly known as the Delta-crested Bolbitis or Delta-crested Water Fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Lomariopsidaceae. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bolbitis virens var. deltigera include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and potential anti-cancer properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, further research is needed to confirm the extent and full potential of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
